title: Spiced Leek and Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and finely chopped
TO SERVE: sprinkling of smoked paprika, pepper
method: Spray a large saucepan with oil and fry the onion, leeks and potatoes over a high heat for 2 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, reduce the heat to low, pop the lid on the pan and leave it gently sizzling and sweating for 15 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Remove the lid, increase the heat, add the spices and salt and stir through for about 30 seconds until you can smell the spices. Pour in the hot stock and allow to simmer for 15 minutes.
Use a hand blender to blend the soup to a smooth consistency. Serve sprinkled with a little smoked paprika and pepper.
notes: Serve with warm pitta bread. Great served with the Wholemeal Pitta Bread on page 202.
